name: write
description: Save complete literal UTF-8 text/HTML without shell quoting. Use either path/content for one file or files:[{path,content,expectedRevision?}] for an atomic batch. Omitted expectedRevision or 0 creates only: existing files fail unchanged. To overwrite, call read first, then pass its revision as expectedRevision. On conflict read again before deciding to overwrite. createParents=true creates missing parent directories. Returns saved path, revision and bytes; no extra write is needed to confirm success.

path.description: VFS path: ~ is /home/user; relative paths use this agent's cwd. Paths are case-sensitive.

content.description: Complete literal UTF-8 text to save, including actual line breaks. No shell quoting or HTML escaping is needed. Replaces the entire file; not an append.

expectedRevision.description: For write, omitted or 0 means create only. To overwrite, read the file first and pass its returned revision here. After a conflict, read again; do not guess or reuse a stale revision. For edit, optional additional revision check.

createParents.description: Create missing parent directories; default false. Directory creation occurs before the file write batch.

files.description: Atomic batch of 1–32 files; cannot combine with top-level path/content. Each existing file needs its own expectedRevision.
